- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asked how the user's snake plant is doing so far.
- [EVENT] User is thinking of propagating some of their existing plants to add to their balcony garden.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to successfully propagate Pothos cuttings in water, including:
  - Materials needed: healthy Pothos plant, clean container, water, sharp knife or pruning scissors, optional rooting hormone.
  - Step-by-step propagation guide with 9 detailed steps.
- [EVENT] User has already tried propagating some Pothos cuttings in water and can see tiny roots starting to form after three weeks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided advice on when to transplant the Pothos cuttings into soil and how to care for them after transplanting, including:
  - Wait until roots are 1-2 inches long.
  - Use well-draining potting mix and a pot with drainage holes.
  - Watering, humidity, lighting, temperature, fertilization, and pruning tips.
- [EVENT] User is considering pruning their mint plant on the balcony as it is getting leggy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to prune mint correctly to encourage new growth, including:
  - Inspect the plant, cut back long stems, pinch off tips, and prune regularly.
